text:
Detailed review (I think):
The clinic itself is very clean and pleasant to the eye. The staff are lovely, very cheerful and friendly. 🥰💖 The doctor and medical assistants are also very nice, speaking politely without any tantrums or negativity. I asked a lot of questions, but the doctor paid close attention to them and gave very detailed advice. Anything I didn't understand, the doctor explained without getting annoyed. In short, it was excellent, the best, the absolute best. I'm not exaggerating, it's the truth! 😍
